title: The Scriveners
author: Commander M. V. Coehoorn
excerpt: The Scriveners are a nomadic clan of scribes, scientists and knowledge-keepers. They travel through deep space onboard a self-sufficient Dredger-class bulk cruiser, completely isolated from human civilization and the politics of the bubble. History According to information provided by spokespersons of the Orion University, the history of the Scrivener Clan begins in the year 3088,…
